details.note: High power, high interest. Involve them in decisions and meet often.
High power, low interest. Brief them on what matters to them, without swamping them.
Low power, high interest. Share progress regularly and ask for their views.
Low power, low interest. Check in now and then in case that changes.
Sunday pay rates and rotas are the sticking point.
Could move up to Keep informed if Sunday footfall grows.

name: Stakeholder map
note: List everyone the change affects, then place each by their power over it and their interest in it: the top row has the most power, the left column the most interest. The note on each quadrant says how to engage.
